buildings.name: Training Ground
levels: 3 Mentor seats; trained recruits promote at level 5.

buildings.name: Scriptorium
levels: Insight 3; once a Year, peek one expedition event.

buildings.name: Infirmary
levels: 2 Scions treated per Year; disease immunity in town.
A Devastating injury may be downgraded once per campaign.

buildings.name: Chapel
levels: Sanity +25% per Year in town; a 2nd promotion slot.
Mental ailment resist +10% for House Scions.
Resurrection and redemption events become possible.

buildings.name: Forge
levels: Craft tier 1 weapons and armor; repair.

buildings.name: Workshop
levels: Constructs can be pre-built for battle.

buildings.name: Vault
levels: Treasury score +10%; immune to theft events.
Treasury score +20%; 5% interest a Year on Gold.

buildings.name: Shrine
levels: Essence +2 per Year; affinity +5% for House Scions.
Once per expedition, one Scion is immune to the House's element for a battle.

buildings.name: Crypt
levels: A Chronicle; Sanity loss from a Scion's death −50%.
Haunting events can be bargained with.
The dead can be asked one question per Year.

buildings.name: Mine
levels: +24 Iron per Year; one random rare material every 3 Years.

buildings.name: Watchtower
levels: Preview next Year's settlement event category.
Ambush events on expeditions: your Scions act first.
